description: Whether one position can actually be filled right now: the balance sitting in the strategy, the maker wallet balance behind it, and the remaining allowance, read from the chain. An Aqua virtual balance is a bookkeeping ceiling, not a reserve, so a position can answer a quote while the wallet behind it is empty - and the swap then reverts at the pull. Check this before signing a swap against a position that matters: fillable=false means the quote is real but the fill is not. Read-only, free, no key, and no dependency on 1inch rate limits.

overview.description: Also fetch 1inch's overview (status, openedAt, price range). Costs the upstream rate limit, so it is off by default.
